Import YouTube subscriptions from Google Takeout: 
 
1. Go to %1$s 
2. Sign in when prompted 
3. Select "All data included", then "Deselect all". Select only "subscriptions" and select "OK" 
4. Select "Next step", then "Create export" 
5. When the "Download" button appears, select it 
6. Select IMPORT FILE below and choose the downloaded .zip file 
7. If importing the .zip file fails, extract the .csv file (usually at "YouTube and YouTube Music/subscriptions/subscriptions.csv"). Select IMPORT FILE below and choose the extracted .csv file

Import a SoundCloud profile using its URL or your ID:

1. Enable "desktop mode" in a web browser (the site is not available on mobile devices)
2. Go to %1$s
3. Sign in when prompted
4. Copy the profile URL you are redirected to

Is your feed loading too slowly\? Try fast mode using the button below or in settings. 
 
PVCPipe offers two ways to load feeds: 
• Fetch the entire subscribed channel. This is slower but more complete. 
• Use a dedicated service endpoint. This is faster but often less complete. 
 
Fast mode may return fewer items or omit details such as duration and item type, making live videos hard to distinguish from other videos. 
 
YouTube's RSS feed is an example of this faster method. 
 
Choose between speed and more complete information.
